name: Timoks Wilde Welt Fieberbrunn
kurzbeschreibung: Timoks Wilde Welt at Streuböden in Fieberbrunn at 1,210 m: Alpine Coaster, forest rope course, climbing park, and water games in Pillerseetal.
beschreibung:
Overview

The action-packed family and mountain adventure Timoks Wilde Welt is located at the Streuböden middle station of the Bergbahnen Fieberbrunn cable cars in the picturesque Pillerseetal valley (Kitzbühel district) at an elevation of around 1,210 metres. Nestled between the gentle alpine pastures and craggy peaks of the Kitzbühel Alps at the foot of the Henne (2,078 m), this multifaceted leisure area offers a wonderful blend of high-alpine nature, adventurous play stations, and exhilarating fun sports for visitors of all ages.

Route & Requirements

The undisputed highlight of the grounds is the spectacular Timoks Alpine Coaster: on a 1,160-metre tracked run, riders hurtle down 115 vertical metres in modern two-seater bobs through thrilling waves, banked curves, and a breathtaking 360-degree giant loop, before being pulled smoothly back to the top. For climbing enthusiasts, the shaded Waldseilgarten (forest rope course) offers exciting challenges: balancing on suspension bridges, rope loops, and swinging beams close to the ground, children and teenagers playfully train their sense of balance. Right next door rises Timoks Kletterpark: on six massive granite blocks, beginners and advanced climbers can tackle more than 30 secured climbing routes of varying difficulty levels. At the centre of the park, the idyllic Wasserspiele-Speicherteich (reservoir pond with water games) invites guests to unwind: on a wooden walkway circling the water, children can cross on wobble rafts, set water wheels in motion, or dig in the shaded sand play area. Along the panoramic circular path, illustrated information boards provide fascinating facts about alpine wildlife such as marmots, chamois, and golden eagles.

Visit & Arrival

Timoks Wilde Welt operates daily during the summer season from mid-May to late October from 08:30 to 17:00. Admission to the adventure world, climbing park, and forest rope course is free; rides on the Alpine Coaster are paid separately. Fares for summer 2025/2026: gondola ascent and descent to Streuböden adults approx. €28.00, youth approx. €21.00, children approx. €14.00; single ride on Timoks Alpine Coaster adults approx. €7.00, children approx. €5.00 (discounted multi-ride passes available). Cable car rides are included with the regional PillerseeTal Card. By car: via the B164 (Hochkönigstraße) from St. Johann in Tirol to Fieberbrunn, following the signs to Bergbahnen Fieberbrunn (large free parking lots at the valley station Lindau 17). By public transport: ÖBB train to Fieberbrunn railway station, and from there the regional Regiobus PillerseeTal runs directly to the Fieberbrunn Bergbahnen stop.

Tips

The gondola up to Streuböden and the circular trails around the reservoir pond are pram-friendly and fully wheelchair accessible without steps. Children aged 8 and over measuring at least 1.30 m in height are allowed to steer the Alpine Coaster alone; younger children from 3 years ride accompanied by an adult. Stop for a bite at the traditional Berggasthof Streuböden or the Enzianhütte to savour authentic homemade Tyrolean Pressknödel.
